lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's forty-two and a half? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 42½? Nope!

lines.text: P one is at zero. P two is at sixty-four.
lines.caption: P1 is at 0. P2 is at 64.

lines.text: Each new point is the midpoint of the two before it. Where is P ten?
lines.caption: Each new point is the midpoint of the two before it. Where is P10?

lines.text: Watch the jumps: sixty-four right, thirty-two left, sixteen right.
lines.caption: Watch the jumps: 64 right, 32 left, 16 right.

lines.text: Each jump is half the last one, and it flips direction!
lines.caption: Each jump is half the last one, and it flips direction!

lines.text: Then eight left, four right, two left, one right.
lines.caption: Then 8 left, 4 right, 2 left, 1 right.

lines.text: Half of that, back left, puts P nine at forty-two and a half.
lines.caption: Half of that, back left, puts P9 at 42½.

lines.text: Last, one quarter to the right. P ten is forty-two and three quarters!
lines.caption: Last, ¼ to the right. P10 is 42¾!

lines.text: Forty-two and a half was the trap.
lines.caption: 42½ was the trap.

lines.text: Did you get forty-two and three quarters? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 42¾? Tell me below!
